title: Add status filtering to GET /tasks
body:
## Request

`GET /tasks` always returns every task. With more than a handful of tasks the client has to filter locally, which means transferring rows it will immediately discard.

Support a `status` query parameter:

```
GET /tasks?status=todo
GET /tasks?status=in-progress
GET /tasks?status=done
```

## Expected behaviour

- `?status=todo` returns only tasks in that status.
- `count` reflects the number of tasks returned, not the total in the store.
- An invalid status returns `400` with an error listing the valid values, matching how `POST /tasks` already validates status.
- Omitting the parameter keeps the current behaviour: return everything.

## Notes

The route already has a `VALID_STATUSES` array and an `isValidStatus` helper. Reuse them rather than duplicating the list.
expected_behaviour: GET /tasks?status=<valid> filters the result set and reports the filtered count. Invalid status yields 400. Omitted status returns all tasks unchanged.
notes: Additive change. Exercises reuse of existing helpers rather than writing new validation.
